defense_news.title: US Army eyes developing soldier-worn drone detection gear
defense_news.summary: The Army is in the early stages of developing and testing a wearable or lightweight device that could alert soldiers to the presence of hostile drones.

defense_news.title: ‘Revolutionary’: Bell touts MV-75 Cheyenne II as combat game changer
defense_news.summary: The Army's MV-75 Cheyenne II is expected to bring increased capability through its speed, range and modular open systems approach.

defense_news.title: Kratos combat drone completes first Euro flight, advances turbojet engine production
defense_news.summary: The company said it is positioning itself to support a range of unmanned missions with new aircraft and engine capabilities.

defense_news.title: US Army to stand up second expeditionary cyber battalion in coming months
defense_news.summary: The head of U.S. Army Cyber Command said this week that the service would be building an exact replica of the 11th Cyber Battalion in the next few months.
